items: -tion, -ence, -ance, -ity, etc. (suffix used to form abstract nouns from verbs, and occasionally from other parts of speech) — отчи́слить (“to deduct, to dismiss”) + -ение → отчисле́ние (“deduction, dismissal”); порази́ть (“to defeat”) + -ение → пораже́ние (“defeat”); прови́деть (“to foresee”) + -ение → прови́дение (“foresight”)

blocks.text: The stress is usually drawn onto the suffix (e.g. отчисле́ние from отчи́слить), but occasionally not (e.g. прови́дение from прови́деть).

This suffix is generally used only for verbs whose past passive participle ends in -енный or -ённый; verbs whose past passive participle ends in -анный normally use -ание, and verbs whose past passive participle ends in -тый normally use -тие.

The stem preceding the suffix is modified in the same way as for the past passive participle; in particular, the stem normally becomes iotated, and in cases where the stem iotates irregularly in the past passive participle (e.g. -жд- instead of -ж-, or -щ- instead of -ч-), the same irregularities are observed before -е́ние.

items: -tion, -ence, -ance, -ity, etc. (suffix used to form abstract nouns from verbs; added especially to verbs ending in -ать) — надоеда́ть (“to annoy”) + -ание → надоеда́ние (“annoyance”); сде́рживать (“to deter”) + -ание → сде́рживание (“deterrence”); ве́шать (“to hang”) + -ание → ве́шание (“hanging”)

blocks.text: The stress is usually not drawn onto the suffix, unlike for -е́ние (but note ды́хать (“to breathe”) → дыха́ние (“breath, breathing”)).
